edition.en: Chapter 1 of the Xunzi, complete, as given on Chinese Wikisource, with the interlinear commentary of Yang Liang (Tang dynasty) removed.
edition.zh: 《荀子》第一篇全文，据维基文库，删去唐代杨倞的夹注。

basis.en: Classical Chinese text of the Warring States period; the author died about 235 BCE.
basis.zh: 战国古典文本，作者约卒于公元前 235 年。

note.en: The first chapter of the Xunzi, a long argument that people are made by what they learn, as wood is made straight by the carpenter’s line. It is shelved complete. Notice the earthworm, with no claws and no strong bones, that still reaches the deep springs because its mind is on one thing.
note.zh: 《荀子》首篇，长篇论证人由所学而成，正如木受绳则直。全文上架。留意那条蚯蚓：没有爪牙之利、筋骨之强，却因“用心一也”，能下饮黄泉。

excerpt.orig: 不積跬步，無以至千里；不積小流，無以成江海。
excerpt.en: Without piling up single steps, there is no way to reach a thousand miles. Without piling up little streams, there is no way to make a river or a sea.
excerpt.zh: 不积跬步，无以至千里；不积小流，无以成江海。

gloss.en: 藍: the indigo plant, from which blue dye is drawn. The line gave the idiom 青出於藍: the pupil who surpasses the teacher.
gloss.zh: 蓝：蓼蓝，可提炼靛青。后成成语“青出于蓝”，比喻学生胜过老师。

gloss.en: 輮 is read as 煣: to bend wood over fire or steam.
gloss.zh: 𫐓：通“煣”，用火烤使木材弯曲。

gloss.en: 礪: a whetstone.
gloss.zh: 砺：磨刀石。

gloss.en: 參: some read it as 三, several times a day; others as 驗, to examine.
gloss.zh: 参：一说通“叁”，多次；一说检验。

gloss.en: 于 is read as 干 (Gan), a small state later absorbed by Wu. Yue lay to the southeast, the Yi to the east, the Mo to the north.
gloss.zh: 于：通“干”，古国名，后为吴所灭。越在东南，夷在东方，貉在北方。

gloss.en: From the Book of Songs (Lesser Odes, ‘Xiao Ming’). 靖共: quietly diligent. 介: to grant. 景福: great blessing.
gloss.zh: 出自《诗经·小雅·小明》。靖共：恭谨。介：给予。景福：大福。

gloss.en: 跂: to stand on tiptoe.
gloss.zh: 跂：踮起脚跟。

gloss.en: The meng dove: usually taken to be the wren or tailorbird, known for its hanging woven nest.
gloss.zh: 蒙鸠：一说即鹪鹩，善于编织悬挂的鸟巢。

gloss.en: The flowering tassel of a reed.
gloss.zh: 苇苕：芦苇的花穗。

gloss.en: Shegan (射 is read ye): the blackberry lily, a hillside plant, which Xunzi calls a tree.
gloss.zh: 射（yè）干：一种草本植物，生于山地；荀子称之为“木”。

gloss.en: 仞: an old measure of seven or eight Chinese feet.
gloss.zh: 仞：古代长度单位，七尺或八尺为一仞。

gloss.en: 蘭槐: a fragrant herb; its root is 芷, angelica, carried in scent pouches.
gloss.zh: 兰槐：一种香草，它的根叫白芷，可做香料佩戴。

gloss.en: 漸: to steep. 滫: foul water, slops.
gloss.zh: 渐：浸泡。滫：臭水、泔水。

gloss.en: Some read 柱 as 祝, to break: what is too hard brings about its own breaking.
gloss.zh: 柱：一说通“祝”，折断；意谓过于坚硬反而自取折断。

gloss.en: 醯: vinegar. 蜹: a gnat.
gloss.zh: 醯：醋。蜹：蚊类小虫。

gloss.en: 跬: half a pace. One lift of a foot was a 跬, two made a 步.
gloss.zh: 跬：半步。古人以抬一次脚为跬，两次为步。

gloss.en: 騏驥: a fine horse. 駑馬: a worn-out nag. 駕: a day’s journey in harness.
gloss.zh: 骐骥：骏马。驽马：劣马。驾：马拉车走一天的路程。

gloss.en: 鍥: to carve, to cut. 鏤 below: to engrave.
gloss.zh: 锲：刻。下文“镂”：雕刻。

gloss.en: 跪: a crab’s leg. A crab in fact has eight, and some texts read 八跪. 螯: the pincers.
gloss.zh: 跪：蟹腿。螃蟹实有八条腿，一本作“八跪”。螯：蟹钳。

gloss.en: 冥冥 and 惛惛 (in the next clause): deep, silent, wholly absorbed.
gloss.zh: 冥冥、惛惛（下句）：都指专心致志、深沉不露的样子。

gloss.en: 梧鼠, read as 鼫鼠, was said to have five skills and master none: it could fly but not over a roof, climb but not to the treetop, swim but not across a gully, dig but not hide itself, run but not outrun a man.
gloss.zh: 梧鼠：即鼫鼠。相传它有五种本领：能飞不能过屋，能爬不能到树顶，能游不能渡山谷，能挖洞不能藏身，能跑不能跑在人前。

gloss.en: From the Book of Songs (Odes of Cao, ‘Shi Jiu’). The cuckoo was said to feed its seven young evenly, from the top down in the morning and from the bottom up at evening.
gloss.zh: 出自《诗经·曹风·鸤鸠》。相传布谷鸟喂养七只雏鸟，早上从上往下喂，晚上从下往上喂，平均如一。

gloss.en: Hu Ba: a zither player of legend, whose music made fish leap and birds dance.
gloss.zh: 瓠巴：传说中善于弹瑟的人，据说他奏乐时鸟舞鱼跃。

gloss.en: Bo Ya: the great qin player whose friend Zhong Ziqi alone understood his music. 秣: fodder.
gloss.zh: 伯牙：古代善弹琴的人，与钟子期为知音。秣：草料。

gloss.en: 端 is read as 喘, a breath: the slightest word. 蝡: to wriggle: the smallest movement.
gloss.zh: 端：通“喘”，指微言。蝡：微动。

gloss.en: Birds and calves were customary gifts: learning made into a present to win favour.
gloss.zh: 禽犊：禽鸟和小牛，古人用作馈赠的礼物；比喻把学问当作取悦他人的礼品。

gloss.at: 若挈裘領，詘五指而頓之
gloss.at_hans: 若挈裘领，诎五指而顿之
gloss.en: 挈: to lift. 詘 is read as 屈, to bend. 頓: to give a shake.
gloss.zh: 挈：提起。诎：通“屈”，弯曲。顿：抖动。

gloss.en: 飡 is the same as 餐: to eat out of a pot with an awl.
gloss.zh: 飡：同“餐”。用锥子到壶里取食。

gloss.en: From the Book of Songs (Lesser Odes, ‘Cai Shu’). 交 is read as 絞, impatient; 舒, slack.
gloss.zh: 出自《诗经·小雅·采菽》。交：通“绞”，急躁。舒：怠慢。

gloss.en: 光 is read as 廣: broad.
gloss.zh: 光：通“广”，广大。
